principles: Every production image asset has exactly one canonical registry record.
Use the highest-quality approved source available; never repeatedly transcode an already compressed derivative when a better source exists.
Optimization must preserve approved composition. Book covers and identity assets are composition-locked.
Prefer SVG for native vectors, AVIF for high-quality photographic/cover delivery when compatibility is verified, and WebP as a robust raster alternative.

Do not invent or upscale missing source detail. A production derivative may temporarily serve as the approved source when the original master is not stored in the repository, but provenance must say so.
Replacing an unversioned image at the same URL remains fresh-first under the cache standard; immutable caching is allowed only for identity-stable versioned/fingerprinted URLs.
public_rights_rule: Public assets must have explicit site-use approval/provenance. UNKNOWN or RESTRICTED rights are prohibited.

book_cover_profile.source_rule: Retain an approved master/source when available; otherwise record the approved production asset as the current source without pretending it is an original master.
